title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers to 1,200
seo_title: Grade 2 Comparing and Ordering Numbers Worksheets (TEKS 2.2C, 2.2D)
standard_text: 2.2C generate a number that is greater than or less than a given whole number up to 1,200; 2.2D use place value to compare and order whole numbers up to 1,200 using comparative language, numbers, and symbols (>, <, or =)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 worksheets for Texas TEKS 2.2C and 2.2D: compare numbers to 1,200 with base-ten blocks and place value, use >, < and =, order numbers and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Compare the biggest place first: thousands, then hundreds, then tens, then ones.
  • > means greater than; < means less than. The open side faces the bigger number.
  • To order numbers, compare them two at a time.

Examples

Example

Compare 482 and 428.

Hundreds are the same: 4 = 4

Tens: 8 > 2

Answer: 482 > 428

Example

Compare 1,015 and 998.

1,015 has 1 thousand

998 has 0 thousands

Answer: 1,015 > 998

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Comparing the ones firstStart with the biggest place.
Flipping the symbolThe open side faces the bigger number.
Thinking more 9s means bigger1,000 > 999, because 1 thousand is more than 9 hundreds.

sets.title: Order numbers and find greater or less

items.q: Put 352, 235 and 325 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 235 < 325 (2 hundreds < 3 hundreds), and 325 < 352 (2 tens < 5 tens). So from least to greatest: 235, 325, 352.

items.q: Put 481, 399 and 418 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 399 < 418 (3 hundreds < 4 hundreds), and 418 < 481 (1 ten < 8 tens). So from least to greatest: 399, 418, 481.

items.q: Put 450, 504 and 405 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 405 < 450 (0 tens < 5 tens), and 450 < 504 (4 hundreds < 5 hundreds). So from least to greatest: 405, 450, 504.

items.q: Put 726, 762 and 672 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 672 < 726 (6 hundreds < 7 hundreds), and 726 < 762 (2 tens < 6 tens). So from least to greatest: 672, 726, 762.

items.q: Put 190, 109 and 901 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 109 < 190 (0 tens < 9 tens), and 190 < 901 (1 hundred < 9 hundreds). So from least to greatest: 109, 190, 901.

items.q: Put 843, 834 and 438 in order from least to greatest.
items.e: 438 < 834 (4 hundreds < 8 hundreds), and 834 < 843 (3 tens < 4 tens). So from least to greatest: 438, 834, 843.

items.e: 716 > 671 (7 hundreds > 6 hundreds), and 671 > 617 (7 tens > 1 ten). So from greatest to least: 716, 671, 617.

items.q: Put 299, 302 and 320 in order from greatest to least.
items.e: 320 > 302 (2 tens > 0 tens), and 302 > 299 (3 hundreds > 2 hundreds). So from greatest to least: 320, 302, 299.

items.e: 963 > 936 (6 tens > 3 tens), and 936 > 699 (9 hundreds > 6 hundreds). So from greatest to least: 963, 936, 699.

items.q: A red bag has 516 beads. A blue bag has 561 beads. Which is true?
items.e: Both have 5 hundreds. Look at the tens next. 516 has 1 ten and 561 has 6 tens. 1 < 6, so 516 < 561. The ones do not matter. So the red bag has fewer beads.

items.q: A train has 408 seats. A plane has 480 seats. Which is true?
items.e: Both have 4 hundreds. Look at the tens next. 408 has 0 tens and 480 has 8 tens. 0 < 8, so 408 < 480. The ones do not matter. So the plane has more seats.

c: The same number came each day.
items.e: Both have 9 hundreds. Look at the tens next. 937 has 3 tens and 973 has 7 tens. 3 < 7, so 937 < 973. The ones do not matter. So more people came on Tuesday.

items.e: Fewer than 452 means less than 452. Both have 4 hundreds. Look at the tens next. 449 has 4 tens and 452 has 5 tens. 4 < 5, so 449 < 452. The ones do not matter. 524 and 460 are greater. 452 is the same number.

items.q: Four friends played a game. Camila got 342 points. Grace got 324 points. Liam got 299 points. Mateo got 304 points. Who got the most points?
items.e: Compare 342, 324, 299 and 304. Hundreds first: 3, 3, 2 and 3. 3 is the biggest. Tens of 342, 324 and 304: 4, 2 and 0. 4 is the biggest. So Camila got the most points: 342.

items.q: Four classes collected cans. Room 1 collected 418 cans. Room 2 collected 408 cans. Room 3 collected 480 cans. Room 4 collected 410 cans. Which class collected the fewest cans?
items.e: Compare 418, 408, 480 and 410. All of them have 4 hundreds. Tens: 1, 0, 8 and 1. 0 is the smallest. So Room 2 collected the fewest cans: 408.

items.q: Four kids counted the pages they read this year. Nevaeh read 506 pages. Isaac read 499 pages. Harper read 550 pages. Emma read 560 pages. Who read the most pages?
items.e: Compare 506, 499, 550 and 560. Hundreds first: 5, 4, 5 and 5. 5 is the biggest. Tens of 506, 550 and 560: 0, 5 and 6. 6 is the biggest. So Emma read the most pages: 560.

items.q: Bag A has 263 beads. Bag B has 326 beads. Bag C has 236 beads. Bag D has 362 beads. Which bag has the fewest beads?
items.e: Compare 263, 326, 236 and 362. Hundreds first: 2, 3, 2 and 3. 2 is the smallest. Tens of 263 and 236: 6 and 3. 3 is the smallest. So Bag C has the fewest beads: 236.

items.q: Four farms picked apples. Hill Farm picked 709 apples. Oak Farm picked 790 apples. Sun Farm picked 779 apples. Lake Farm picked 797 apples. Which farm picked the most apples?
items.e: Compare 709, 790, 779 and 797. All of them have 7 hundreds. Tens: 0, 9, 7 and 9. 9 is the biggest. Ones of 790 and 797: 0 and 7. 7 is the biggest. So Lake Farm picked the most apples: 797.

items.q: What is the greatest number you can make with the digits 3, 8 and 1? Use each digit once.
items.e: Put the biggest digit in the hundreds place, the next biggest in the tens place, and the smallest in the ones place: 8, 3, 1. The greatest number is 831.

items.q: What is the least number you can make with the digits 6, 2 and 9? Use each digit once.
items.e: Put the smallest digit in the hundreds place, the next smallest in the tens place, and the biggest in the ones place: 2, 6, 9. The least number is 269.

items.q: What is the least number you can make with the digits 5, 0 and 7? Use each digit once.
items.e: A three-digit number cannot start with 0. Put the smallest digit that is not 0 in the hundreds place: 5. Then put 0 in the tens place and 7 in the ones place. The least number is 507.
